en.meta_title: Canban — AI-Native Kanban Workbench for Coding Agents (Kanban + Workflow + Herdr)
en.meta_desc: Canban is an open-source native macOS and Linux Kanban workbench for coding agents. Maintain Human Context on Kanban cards, automate isolated Git worktrees & Queue Merge with custom Workflows, and run Claude Code, Codex, or Agy inside Herdr persistent PTY terminals.
en.hero_subtitle: Turn Kanban cards into automated coding workflows.
en.hero_description: Keep using your native agent CLIs, including Claude Code and Codex, while Canban handles task context, isolated Git worktrees, and merging.
en.tl_msg_1: Build a bold retro CRT Monokai deck, one screen per channel.
en.tl_msg_2: Redrew full width Workflow Studio and live Agent CLI view.

en.wn_2_sub: Isolated Git worktree · awaits explicit CLI report
en.wn_4_sub: FIFO batch integration & upstream branch sync

en.ascii_title: Parallel Agents. Isolated Worktrees. Zero Conflict Delivery.
en.al_1: Zero branch collisions: every Card gets its own clean checkout
en.al_2: Bring any native Agent CLI inside persistent Herdr TTYs
en.al_3: Automatic FIFO rebase merge, upstream push & worktree cleanup
en.closing_title: Unburden your mind. Keep your Human Context.
en.closing_seo_note: Canban = Kanban + Workflow + Herdr — Maintain Human Context with Kanban, schedule with custom Workflows, and power native Agent CLIs with Herdr.
